after = df[df['years for jazz'].str.extract(r'(\d{4})')[0].astype(int) > 1985]
us = after[after['nationality'] == 'united states']
count_ok = len(us) == 4
most_recent = us.loc[us['years for jazz'].str.extract(r'(\d{4})')[0].astype(int).idxmax(), 'player']
answer = bool(count_ok and most_recent == 'louis amundson')

The US players after 1985 are: isaac austin (1991-93), anthony avent (1998-99), shandon anderson (1996-99), and louis amundson (2007) — exactly 4 players, with amundson being the most recent. So the answer is **True**.
